links.comparator_used: Full dataset with no referral (all model segmentations retained, no uncertainty-based rejection)
links.outcome: Segmentation accuracy (DSC) after referring high-uncertainty patients
links.effect: DSC improved from the full dataset by 4.7% (MC Dropout Ensemble) and 5.0% (Deep Ensemble) using uncertainty thresholds from 0.85 validation DSC, averaged over all uncertainty measures
links.tradeoff: 21.8% (MC Dropout Ensemble) and 22% (Deep Ensemble) of patients were referred, i.e. rejected from the set
links.quote: With referring patients based on uncertainty thresholds from 0.85 validation DSC for all uncertainty measures, on average the DSC improved from the full dataset by 4.7% and 5.0% while referring 21.8% and 22% patients for MC Dropout Ensemble and Deep Ensemble, respectively.
